CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.label: solar lens laser
CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.description: Batteries and reagents that can power a chemlaser emitter. The reagents generates laser at visible wavelengths through a starBOR_Neutronium laser.

CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.label: infrared laser neutronium
CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.description: Batteries and reagents that can power a neutronium laser emitter. The reagents generates laser at infrared wavelengths, causing burns and start fires.

CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.label: untraviolet laser neutronium
CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.description: Batteries and reagents that can power a neutronium laser emitter. The reagents generates laser at untraviolet wavelengths, delivering more energy and causing more damage.

CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.label: Neutronium EM laser
CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.description: Batteries and reagents that can power a neutronium laser emitter. The reagents generates laser at radio wavelengths, disrupting electronic systems.

CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.label: stun laser
CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.description: Batteries and reagents that power a low-intensity stun laser emitter, delivering a disabling electrical jolt without lasting harm.

CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.label: neuralizer laser
CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.description: Batteries and reagents that power a neuralizer emitter, disrupting the target's nervous system to induce a brief, non-lethal collapse.

CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.label: EMP laser
CombatExtended.AmmoCategoryDef.description: Batteries and reagents that power an EMP-tuned emitter, disabling electronics and synthetics without significant harm to organic targets.

ThingDef.label: solar laser rifle
ThingDef.description: A tenebrite-infused laser rifle channeling stellar energy through a neutronium focusing lens. Fires precise teal beams of concentrated solar energy.

ThingDef.label: solar laser sniper rifle
ThingDef.description: A tenebrite-infused laser sniper rifle focusing stellar energy into extreme-range precision beams. Equipped with advanced optics for night engagement.

ThingDef.label: solar laser shotgun
ThingDef.description: A tenebrite-infused scatter laser that fans multiple solar beams in a short-range cone. Devastating at close quarters.

ThingDef.label: solar laser cannon
ThingDef.description: A heavy tenebrite-infused laser cannon that unleashes sustained bursts of solar energy. Requires two hands and a stable firing position.

ThingDef.label: solar laser pistol
ThingDef.description: A compact tenebrite-infused laser sidearm. Easily carried and quick to draw, it fires focused teal solar beams at close range.

ThingDef.label: solar laser bullpup
ThingDef.description: A compact tenebrite-infused bullpup laser carbine. Its shortened frame allows rapid burst fire of concentrated solar beams while remaining easy to maneuver.

ThingDef.label: solar laser DMR
ThingDef.description: A tenebrite-infused designated marksman rifle firing high-energy solar beams at extreme range. Pairs a bipod with advanced targeting optics for precision engagements.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam rifle
ThingDef.description: A standard-issue kwazaari beam rifle retuned for less-than-lethal crowd control and detainment operations. Its emitter trades armor-piercing output for a disabling stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic discharge, incapacitating hostiles without lethal harm.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam sniper rifle
ThingDef.description: The most precise less-than-lethal beam weapon in the kwazaari lineup. Its advanced optical focusing array delivers a disabling stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulse at extreme range, incapacitating high-value targets without lethal harm.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam scatter
ThingDef.description: A close-quarters kwazaari beam scatter weapon retuned for less-than-lethal riot suppression. Its modified prism fans a stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulse across multiple targets, incapacitating a crowd without lethal casualties.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam lmg
ThingDef.description: A heavy-duty kwazaari beam repeater retuned for less-than-lethal area suppression. Its high-capacity focusing arrays deliver sustained bursts of stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulses, incapacitating hostile crowds without lethal force.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam pistol
ThingDef.description: A compact kwazaari beam sidearm retuned for less-than-lethal security work. Its sealed electromagnetic emitter delivers a disabling stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulse instead of live ammunition, making it the sidearm of choice for shipboard security and riot suppression aboard vacuum-sealed spacecraft.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam bullpup
ThingDef.description: A compact kwazaari beam carbine retuned for less-than-lethal close-quarters detainment. Its bullpup configuration allows rapid follow-up stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulses in confined spaces without risking lethal casualties.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam dmr
ThingDef.description: A precision kwazaari beam designated marksman weapon retuned for less-than-lethal takedown operations. Its tight beam focus delivers a disabling stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulse at range, incapacitating a single target without lethal harm.
